content.json:
# Mimecast Human Risk

Monitor your organization's human risk posture using data from the Mimecast Human Risk connector. This workbook includes:

- **Risk Overview** - average human risk score, risk response activity and how individuals are spread across risk factors.
- **Risk Trends** - monthly human risk and attack scores.
- **Highest Human Risks** - top 10 individuals, departments or locations by human risk score.
- **Human Risk Behaviors and Organization Attacks** - scores and event breakdowns by behavior and attack type.

>**NOTE:** This workbook depends on parsers based on Kusto functions - **MimecastHumanRiskOrganization**, **MimecastHumanRiskBehaviors**, **MimecastHumanRiskAttacks** and **MimecastHumanRiskIndividuals** - which are deployed with the Microsoft Sentinel Solution.

Data is collected as snapshots at the polling interval chosen in the connector (default 12 hours). Each panel shows the latest snapshot inside the selected time range, so keep the time range at least as long as the polling interval.

## Risk Overview
Average human risk, risk-response activity and how individuals are distributed across risk factors.

content.query:
MimecastHumanRiskIndividuals | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IndividualId | where isnotnull(HumanRiskScore)
| summarize Value = round(avg(HumanRiskScore), 1) | extend Metric = 'Average Human Risk Score (0-100)'
content.title: Human Risk Score

content.query:
let T = MimecastHumanRiskOrganization | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Month;
T | summarize Notifications = avg(Notifications), GroupChanges = avg(GroupChanges), TotalActions = avg(TotalActions)
| project Metric = dynamic(['Notifications','Group Changes','Risk Activity']), Value = pack_array(Notifications, GroupChanges, TotalActions)
| mv-expand Metric to typeof(string), Value to typeof(real)
| project Metric, Value = round(Value, 1)
content.title: Notifications, Group Changes and Risk Activity

content.query:
MimecastHumanRiskIndividuals | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IndividualId | where isnotnull(HumanRiskScore)
| extend Bucket = case(isempty(HumanRiskFactor) or HumanRiskFactor == 'notScored', 'Not Scored', HumanRiskFactor == 'veryLow', 'Very Low', HumanRiskFactor == 'low', 'Low', HumanRiskFactor == 'medium', 'Medium', HumanRiskFactor == 'high', 'High', HumanRiskFactor == 'veryHigh', 'Very High', 'Not Scored')
| summarize Count = count() by Bucket
| extend o = case(Bucket == 'Very Low', 1, Bucket == 'Low', 2, Bucket == 'Medium', 3, Bucket == 'High', 4, Bucket == 'Very High', 5, 6) | sort by o asc | project-away o
content.title: Human Risk Factor Distribution

content.query:
MimecastHumanRiskIndividuals | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IndividualId | where isnotnull(HumanRiskScore)
| extend Bucket = case(isempty(AttackFactor) or AttackFactor == 'notScored', 'Not Scored', AttackFactor == 'veryLow', 'Very Low', AttackFactor == 'low', 'Low', AttackFactor == 'medium', 'Medium', AttackFactor == 'high', 'High', AttackFactor == 'veryHigh', 'Very High', 'Not Scored')
| summarize Count = count() by Bucket
| extend o = case(Bucket == 'Very Low', 1, Bucket == 'Low', 2, Bucket == 'Medium', 3, Bucket == 'High', 4, Bucket == 'Very High', 5, 6) | sort by o asc | project-away o
content.title: Attack Factor Distribution

content.json:
## Risk Trends
Monthly organization human risk and attack scores.

content.query:
MimecastHumanRiskOrganization | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where RecordType == 'Monthly' | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Month
| project Month, ['Human Risk Score'] = HumanRiskScore
| sort by Month asc
content.title: Human Risk Score Trends

content.query:
MimecastHumanRiskOrganization | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where RecordType == 'Monthly' | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Month
| project Month, ['Risk Responses'] = coalesce(RiskResponses, 0)
| sort by Month asc
content.title: Human Risk Score Trends - Risk Responses

content.query:
MimecastHumanRiskOrganization | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where RecordType == 'Monthly' | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Month
| where isnotnull(AttackScore)
| project Month, ['Attack Score'] = AttackScore
| sort by Month asc
content.title: Attack Score Trends

content.json:
## Highest Human Risks
Top 10 individuals, departments or locations. Use the selector to switch views.

content.query:
MimecastHumanRiskIndividuals | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IndividualId | where isnotnull(HumanRiskScore)
| project ['FULL NAME'] = coalesce(DisplayName, '-'), ['HUMAN RISK SCORE'] = HumanRiskScore, EMAIL = coalesce(EmailAddress, '-'), MANAGER = coalesce(ManagerName, '-'), DEPARTMENT = coalesce(Department, '-'), LOCATION = coalesce(Location, '-'), ['SIMULATED PHISHING'] = SimulatedPhishingScore, ['ACTUAL PHISHING'] = ActualPhishingScore, TRAINING = TrainingScore, MALWARE = MalwareScore, ['SENSITIVE DATA HANDLING'] = SensitiveDataHandlingScore, ['TENURE DURATION (MONTHS)'] = TenureMonths, ['ATTACK FACTOR'] = case(isempty(AttackFactor) or AttackFactor == 'notScored', 'Not Scored', AttackFactor == 'veryLow', 'Very Low', AttackFactor == 'low', 'Low', AttackFactor == 'medium', 'Medium', AttackFactor == 'high', 'High', AttackFactor == 'veryHigh', 'Very High', 'Not Scored')
| top 10 by ['HUMAN RISK SCORE'] desc
| serialize ['S.NO'] = row_number()
| project-reorder ['S.NO']
content.title: Individuals Highest Human Risks

content.query:
MimecastHumanRiskIndividuals | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IndividualId | where isnotnull(HumanRiskScore)
| extend Grp = iff(isempty(Department), 'Not Provided', Department)
| summarize ['# OF INDIVIDUALS'] = count(), ['HUMAN RISK SCORE'] = round(avg(HumanRiskScore), 1), ['SIMULATED PHISHING'] = round(avg(SimulatedPhishingScore), 1), ['ACTUAL PHISHING'] = round(avg(ActualPhishingScore), 1), TRAINING = round(avg(TrainingScore), 1), MALWARE = round(avg(MalwareScore), 1), ['SENSITIVE DATA HANDLING'] = round(avg(SensitiveDataHandlingScore), 1) by DEPARTMENT = Grp
| top 10 by ['HUMAN RISK SCORE'] desc
| serialize ['S.NO'] = row_number()
| project-reorder ['S.NO']
content.title: Departments Highest Human Risks

content.query:
MimecastHumanRiskIndividuals | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IndividualId | where isnotnull(HumanRiskScore)
| extend Grp = iff(isempty(Location), 'Not Provided', Location)
| summarize ['# OF INDIVIDUALS'] = count(), ['HUMAN RISK SCORE'] = round(avg(HumanRiskScore), 1), ['SIMULATED PHISHING'] = round(avg(SimulatedPhishingScore), 1), ['ACTUAL PHISHING'] = round(avg(ActualPhishingScore), 1), TRAINING = round(avg(TrainingScore), 1), MALWARE = round(avg(MalwareScore), 1), ['SENSITIVE DATA HANDLING'] = round(avg(SensitiveDataHandlingScore), 1) by LOCATION = Grp
| top 10 by ['HUMAN RISK SCORE'] desc
| serialize ['S.NO'] = row_number()
| project-reorder ['S.NO']
content.title: Locations Highest Human Risks

content.json: Click a row to see its event breakdown.

content.query:
MimecastHumanRiskBehaviors | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by BehaviorType
| project STAGE = BehaviorName, ['HUMAN RISK FACTOR'] = FactorLabel, ['HUMAN RISK SCORE'] = Score, ['TOTAL EVENTS'] = EventCount
| sort by ['TOTAL EVENTS'] desc
content.title: Human Risk Behaviors (click a row to see event breakdown)

content.query:
MimecastHumanRiskBehaviors | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by BehaviorType
| where BehaviorName == '{selected_behavior}'
| extend k = bag_keys(Events) | mv-expand k to typeof(string)
| project ['EVENT TYPE'] = k, COUNT = toint(Events[k])
| where isnotnull(COUNT)
| sort by COUNT desc
content.title: Event Breakdown for {selected_behavior}

content.json: Click a row to see its event breakdown.

content.query:
MimecastHumanRiskAttacks | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where isnotempty(AttackType) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AttackType
| project ATTACKTYPE = AttackTypeName, ['ATTACK FACTOR'] = AttackTypeFactorLabel, ['ATTACK SCORE'] = AttackTypeScore, ['TOTAL EVENTS'] = AttackTypeTotal
| sort by ['TOTAL EVENTS'] desc
content.title: Organization Attacks (click a row to see event breakdown)

content.query:
MimecastHumanRiskAttacks | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where isnotempty(AttackType) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AttackType
| where AttackTypeName == '{selected_attack}'
| extend k = bag_keys(AttackTypeEvents) | mv-expand k to typeof(string)
| project ['EVENT TYPE'] = k, COUNT = toint(AttackTypeEvents[k])
| where isnotnull(COUNT)
| sort by COUNT desc
content.title: Event Breakdown for {selected_attack}
